set_dm: I'll DM you. If your DMs are closed, I'll ping you here instead.
list_empty: Nothing coming up. Set one with {cmd}.
bad_time: I couldn't read that time. Try `30m`, `2h`, `1h30m` or `3d`.
out_of_range: Pick a time between 1 minute and 30 days.
no_text: Tell me what to remind you about.
too_many: You already have {max} reminders waiting. Cancel one in the list first.
due_late: Sorry it's late: I was restarting when it was due.
due_fallback: Your DMs are closed, so I'm reminding you here.
already_done: That reminder was already sent or cancelled.
usage:
**Set a reminder:** `{p}remind 1h Take a break` or `{p}remind 2h30m Scrim with the team`
**See yours:** `{p}remind list`
Times from `1m` to `30d`.
